name: Sakura Kiri
source:
A squeamish, distrustful girl who hates and has a fear of [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url]. She is [url=https://vndb.org/c3661]Miki[/url]'s best friend. Kiri and Miki had been nicknamed "The Flowers" by Taichi, because he thinks of them like "two flowers from the same pot."

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
